doubts: Main way is the page's first described walk, Whakahoro to Mangapurua Landing (13 hours); the Ruatītī Road end is a separate start with its own stated time (11 hours), so it is W2. The track can be walked from either direction, which is not a separate way. The Whakahoro start is taken from the place named in the text (T11); the features F2 and F3 are road ends on Oio Road near it and are not used. Ruatītī Road has no feature, so W2's start has no ref. The distance is not stated for either whole way (the packet gives an aggregate '35.5 | 40 km one way'), so both are null. The text's intro has a garbled line ('11 hours 4 hours to Mangapurua/Kaiwhakauka junction'); only '11 hours' is used. No huts are named; the Mosley and Johnson's shelters and campsites are not huts. The mountain-biking option 'From Ruatītī Road over to Whakahoro via the Kaiwhakauka Track' is a combination of the two ways rather than a described way, so it is not listed. The Whakahoro boat exit is from Mangapurua Landing per 'jetboats can be hired ... back to Whakahoro'.
